plugins.description: 3 skills for mortgage loan officers and brokers in Claude and Codex: a monthly social media content calendar, a post writer with a Reg Z trigger-term, APR, NMLS ID and Equal Housing check, and the Thursday Rate Desk that turns this week's Freddie Mac PMMS rate into posts checked against Reg Z, NMLS and Equal Housing, with a rate card. Business memory, drafts in Publora, an autopilot that drafts every Thursday.
